notes: 138 pieces, matching the parts list type by type and colour by colour. The minifigure (helmet, head, torso, legs) is not in the parts list, so it is left out. The 2 track connector pins thrown away on page 25 are also left out.

The booklet builds two models: the excavator (bag 1, pages 5-24) and the level crossing (bag 2, pages 25-40). They are not physically joined. The single sticker sheet b138 has stickers on both, so it links the two in the graph. The excavator drives on the crossing's rails only in the play pictures (pages 42-43), and that is not a connection.

The earlier second group was the spare track b136 with its ring b137, which page 41 shows loose. I joined b136 to the crossing track b93 with the normal track end pegs. The other track-to-track joins are the same type.

Ids follow the booklet order. Where a piece sits underneath one built earlier (b122 on b125, b125 on b127, b129 on b132, b132 on b134 in the barrier arms, and b37 on b41 under the cab), rests_on points forward to the later id. Those pieces are clutched from below.

The booklet is hard to read at some steps, so a few placements are my best reading: the chassis stack on pages 6-7, the cab floor on pages 12-13, the grille bricks b43-b45 on page 14, the hood stack on pages 16-18, and the signal head on page 34. Per-type counts are certain, but some rests_on entries may be a neighbouring piece.
The 2 hinge tiles lego-95120 do not clearly appear in any step. I put them on the crossing track b74, under the slope pairs. Treat that placement as an assumption.
The page 17 step 11 black tile and the step 12 brick stack both seem to use the 4-stud wedge. I resolved this by putting the tile on the 2x6 brick and the stack on the wedge.
Step 17 swaps the hook assembly (b71 and b72) for the bucket b73. I recorded the hook-side joins from steps 14-16 and added the bucket hinge as an alternative.
